lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 10th, 11th, and 12th posterior lines exhibit significant fragmentation, terminating in discrete spot patterns before reaching the ventral hair fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch, positioned anterior to the hind limb junction.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the upper posterior hind limb are aligned on a horizontal axis.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral-lyrate trajectory, extending upward and outward from the skull before curving medially and anteriorly toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.75 times the combined pixel width of both horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately 10-12% of the total vertical horn silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white V-shaped facial chevron between the eyes; three discrete white spots located on the lower mandible/cheek area; contrast-rich orange/tan coloration on lower limbs below the carpal/tarsal joints.
